newsitem.title: USA: Alabama jobless rate dips to 4.5 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Alabama jobless rate dips to 4.5 percent in June.

text.p: Alabama's unemployment rate dipped to 4.5 percent in June from 4.7 percent in May and 5.2 percent a year ago, the state Department of Industrial Relations said Thursday.

Department Director Dottie Blair Cieszynski said the state's unemployment rate had fluctuated between 4.4 percent and 4.9 percent for the last 11 months, and that the economy was strong except in a few rural areas that remain stagnant.
Green County had the state's highest unemployment rate for June, 22.6 percent, and Shelby County had the lowest, 2.1 percent.
